en.summary: Publish a static build to Makers
details: Publish static output built and checked locally or in CI. These examples call the native CLI through swcl edgeone/cli.
<build>: absolute output directory; <name>: target cloud project. Use an authorized account or Makers API Token.
swcl prepares tools as needed. If authorization is missing, run swcl edgeone/auth/setup, then check identity and project access below.
1. Check identity and target project:
swcl edgeone/cli whoami --json  #Show effective identity and workspace
swcl edgeone/cli workspace ls   #Show workspaces cached by native login
When using an API Token, query its workspace. Makers SDK projects.list/listAll lists projects without a local directory association.
Use an Upload project for an existing target. deploy creates a project if the name does not exist.
2. Prepare an upload copy:
Place index.html and other static files at the upload root. If edgeone.json contains source-build settings, change these fields only in the upload copy:
"buildCommand": "", "installCommand": "", "outputDirectory": "."
Change these three fields and keep the other settings, including headers, redirects and rewrites. Leave source-build settings unchanged.
Tests with CLI 1.7.2 showed that Makers runs the uploaded build command. These settings publish static output directly; projects with server code need their own install and bundle settings.
3. Publish to the selected environment:

Run from the target project working directory; use a separate directory for a temporary deployment. The example uses overseas. Select the intended area for a new project; existing projects retain their area.
swcl edgeone/cli makers deploy "<build>" -n <name> -e production -a overseas --skip-ai-gateway-sync --json  #Publish the first deployment
swcl edgeone/cli makers deploy "<build>" -n <name> -e preview --skip-ai-gateway-sync --json                 #Publish a later preview
A new project needs a production deployment before preview. The examples use --skip-ai-gateway-sync to skip AI Gateway credential sync, which static sites do not need.
4. Check deployment and access:
Record the project ID, deployment ID and URL. Wait for success, then check the home page, key assets and response headers.
Use Makers SDK deployments.get/getLog for status and build logs. Default domains have regional and expiry restrictions; check access rules before treating HTTP 401 as a deployment failure.
Tests on 2026-11-14 found that later matching rules replace earlier values for the same header; other headers remain. Use this observation when checking live responses for overlapping rules.
swcl help/en edgeone/deploy/git  #Read the Git build workflow
Project queries: https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/project-operations
Deployments and logs: https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/deployment
Access rules: https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/error-codes
将本地或 CI 已构建并检查的静态产物发布到 Makers。以下通过 swcl edgeone/cli 调用原生 CLI。
<build>：产物目录的绝对路径；<name>：目标云端项目名。需要已授权的账号或 Makers API Token。
工具由 swcl 按需准备；尚未授权时运行 swcl edgeone/auth/setup，随后用下方身份和项目查询核对访问范围。
1. 核对身份与目标项目：
swcl edgeone/cli whoami --json  #查看有效身份与工作区
swcl edgeone/cli workspace ls   #查看原生登录缓存的工作区
使用 API Token 时，按该 Token 的工作区查询。Makers SDK 的 projects.list/listAll 可列出项目，无需先关联本地目录。
已有目标使用 Upload 类型项目；名称不存在时，deploy 会创建项目。
2. 准备上传副本：
把 index.html 等静态文件放在上传目录根部。如 edgeone.json 含源码构建设置，只在上传副本中调整以下字段：
"buildCommand": "", "installCommand": "", "outputDirectory": "."
修改这三个字段，保留 headers、redirects、rewrites 等其余配置。源码中的构建设置保持原样。
CLI 1.7.2 实测会执行上传配置中的构建命令。上述设置用于让平台直接发布静态产物；含服务端代码的项目需另行配置安装与打包。
3. 发布到指定环境：
在目标项目的工作目录执行；临时发布可使用独立目录。以下以 overseas 为例，新项目按服务范围选择区域，已有项目沿用其区域。
swcl edgeone/cli makers deploy "<build>" -n <name> -e production -a overseas --skip-ai-gateway-sync --json  #首次发布
swcl edgeone/cli makers deploy "<build>" -n <name> -e preview --skip-ai-gateway-sync --json                 #后续预览
新项目先完成 production 部署，随后可发布 preview。示例用 --skip-ai-gateway-sync 跳过静态站点不需要的 AI Gateway 凭据同步。
4. 核对部署与访问结果：
记录项目 ID、部署 ID 和地址。等待部署成功，再检查首页、关键资源和响应头。
失败时用 Makers SDK 的 deployments.get/getLog 查询状态和构建日志。平台默认域名有地区和有效期限制，遇到 401 先查访问规则。
2026-11-14 实测，匹配规则中后声明的同名响应头覆盖前值，不同名响应头保留。配置有重叠规则时，可据此检查实际响应。
swcl help/zh edgeone/deploy/git  #查看 Git 托管构建方案
项目查询：https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/project-operations
部署与日志：https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/deployment
访问规则：https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/error-codes
